job.job_description:
Responsibilities


- Develop and implement machine learning models for GenAI projects

- Collaborate with cross-functional teams to identify key opportunities

- Leverage knowledge to create innovative solutions for operational enhancement

- Analyze data to inform model development and performance

- Mentor junior team members in machine learning techniques

- Align projects with strategic business goals

- Monitor project progress and adjust strategies as needed

- Communicate findings and insights to stakeholders effectively


What You Must Have


- Bachelor's or Master's Degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Statistics, or a related field

- 4 years of experience

- Oral and written proficiency in English required


What Sets You Apart


- Experience developing and deploying machine learning applications

- Understanding data privacy and compliance regulations

- Hands-on experience with fine-tuning and quantization of LLMs & RAG

- Proven experience in chatbot design and development

- Practical knowledge of ML/DL frameworks such as TensorFlow, PyTorch, and scikit-learn

- Skilled in object-oriented programming with languages such as Java, C++, or C#

- Relevant certifications in GenAI tools and technologies preferred

-Experience in implementing Model Context Protocol (MCP) preferred
